prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Kansas City. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Kansas City Missouri for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you specific orthodontist names and phone numbers — but first I need two quick clarifying details so the recommendations match your needs:

1. Which Kansas City do you mean (Kansas City, MO or Kansas City, KS) and what ZIP code or neighborhood are you closest to?  
2. Are you an adult or a parent of a child/teen? Any preference for braces vs Invisalign? Also: do you have dental/orthodontic insurance or a budget range?

If you want them right away without those details, I can also pull a general shortlist for the broader Kansas City metro and explain why each is worth calling. Either tell me the location/age/insurance info, or say “give me the general shortlist” and I’ll proceed.

While you decide, here are useful things to look for and the exact questions to ask each office when you call (this will help you pick between them):

What to look for in an orthodontist
- Board certification / credentials: is the orthodontist a Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO)? (ABO diplomate = highest specialty standard)  
- Invisalign experience: are they a certified Invisalign provider, and how many Invisalign cases do they do per year? (Higher volume generally means more experience.)  
- Technology: do they use digital scanners (no messy impressions), CBCT or 3D imaging when needed, and digital treatment planning?  
- Treatment options: do they offer both traditional braces, ceramic braces, Invisalign, and options like lingual braces if you need them?  
- Consult policy & fees: is the initial consultation free or low-cost, do they show before/after photos, and can they give a written estimate?  
- Payment & insurance: payment plans, third‑party financing, and whether they’re in-network with your insurance.  
- Patient experience & reviews: Google/Yelp/Healthgrades ratings, response time, office hours, and whether they treat adults and kids.  
- Follow-up care: how emergencies and retention (retainer policy) are handled.

Questions to ask when you call
- “Do you do Invisalign, and how many Invisalign cases do you treat per year?”  
- “Are you a board-certified orthodontist (ABO Diplomate)?”  
- “Do you use a digital intraoral scanner? Can I see before/after cases like mine?”  
- “What is the typical treatment time and estimated total cost for Invisalign vs braces?”  
- “Is the initial consultation free? Can I get a written estimate and financing options?”  
- “Are you in-network with [your insurance plan]?”  
- “How do you handle emergencies and retention after treatment?”

If you want, give me your ZIP code and whether it’s for an adult or child and I’ll return a short, prioritized list of 4–6 specific orthodontists in your area with why each is a good call (experience with Invisalign, board credentials, tech and patient-review highlights).
